# specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md

```markdown
# SEC filing ingestion — Roadmap

> For agentic workers: REQUIRED SKILL: derive-roadmap — resume via its
> reconcile step; route each unticked stage per its ROUTING line; never plan
> this document wholesale.

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md (both Proposed; the spec's §2.2 puts submissions out of its scope, so O2 and O3 rest on your partner's words alone).
Choices made: Python 3.14 (`.python-version`).
Choices made: a uv workspace of four packages, `sec-edgar-client`, `sec-edgar-download`, `sec-edgar-index-ingest` and `sec-edgar-ingest` (root `pyproject.toml`).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 requests/second; basis: SEC full-index and daily-index directories. Measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks for the full history at 3 requests/second; basis: index row count times the request rate. Not yet measured; Stage 3 measures the per-file rate |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 4 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression).

## Stages

Order follows your partner's progression, with one divergence. Full-history submission download (Stage 5) comes after 10-K/8-K handling on one quarter (Stage 4). The reason is that Stage 4 may narrow which submissions O2 needs at full scale, and that download is the weeks-long cost.

- [ ] Stage 1: Index core
      Objective: Load one real archived quarter's index and one real daily index into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: a filing-index table holding real rows from both source kinds; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: The table holds the rows of one archived quarter and one daily index, with a row count per source. The findings file records the measured wall time, bytes downloaded and SEC request count of the real run.
      Leaves out: full history and daily catch-up (Stage 2); provenance and replay (Stage 6); reconciliation of quarterly changes (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 6); shared request-budget coordination (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Index full history and daily catch-up
      Objective: Extend the filing-index table to every quarter since 1993 and every daily index through today, without duplicate filings where they overlap.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table and findings
      Produces: a complete filing-index table through the latest published daily index
      Exit: The table covers every listed quarterly and daily source, or reports each one it missed by name. Re-running the load adds no duplicate filings.
      Leaves out: provenance and replay (Stage 6); reconciliation of quarterly changes (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 6); shared request-budget coordination (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: Submissions for one quarter
      Objective: Download the submissions that one quarter's index rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2's filing-index table
      Produces: one quarter's submissions on disk, keyed to their index rows
      Exit: Every index row of the chosen quarter has either a downloaded submission or a named failure. The measured per-file download rate and total bytes are recorded in the stage plan's Handoff.
      Leaves out: full-history submissions (Stage 5); provenance and replay (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 6); shared request-budget coordination (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: 10-K and 8-K handling on one quarter
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of Stage 3's submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 3's submissions on disk
      Produces: extracted main documents for one quarter's 10-K and 8-K filings
      Exit: For the chosen quarter, every 10-K and 8-K has an extracted main document or a named failure. The measured extraction time per filing is recorded in the stage plan's Handoff.
      Leaves out: full-history handling (Stage 5); provenance and replay (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Full-history submissions and 10-K/8-K handling
      Objective: Run the downloads and 10-K/8-K handling over the full history, scoped by what Stage 4 showed is needed.
      Outcomes: O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's complete filing-index table; Stages 3 and 4, plan Handoffs
      Produces: full-history submissions on disk, as scoped, and full-history 10-K/8-K main documents
      Exit: Every in-scope index row has a downloaded submission or a named failure, and every 10-K and 8-K has an extracted main document or a named failure. An interrupted run resumes without re-downloading completed files.
      Leaves out: provenance and replay (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 6); shared request-budget coordination (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Provenance, replay, reconciliation and validation
      Objective: Make every output traceable to retained source bytes, add quarterly reconciliation, and cover the system with a full validation suite.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–5, plan Handoffs
      Produces: provenance and replay; reconciliation of quarterly changes; full validation suite
      Exit: Each of the following is shown on real data:
            - A parser change rebuilds the index table and the extracted documents from retained bytes, with no SEC requests.
            - Re-reading a changed quarterly index records its additions, changes and withdrawals.
            - The validation suite runs on committed fixtures in CI.
      Leaves out: shared request-budget coordination (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and reconciliation on a schedule, deployed, with all SEC traffic under one request budget.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 6's provenance and replay and reconciliation of quarterly changes
      Produces: scheduling and deployment; shared request-budget coordination
      Exit: Each of the following is observed:
            - Scheduled daily and reconciliation runs complete and leave durable reports.
            - Concurrent jobs never exceed the configured SEC request rate.
      Leaves out: nothing (the platform is chosen in this stage; the ADR is Proposed)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the
> stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

When every stage is ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list, O1–O3. Give each outcome a verdict, with evidence from its implementing stage and plan, any Deviation notes, and any `specs/deferred_items.md` entries. An unmet outcome exits in one of two ways: a new stage, or a conscious deferral with a written why.
```

Do you approve this order, or want to change it, before Stage 1?
